dimensions.name: API Design and Scaling
dimensions.description: Good candidates demonstrate the ability to design, build, and optimize scalable REST APIs and backend systems using Python or Java.
dimensions.jd_evidence: Design and build scalable REST APIs

dimensions.name: Production Ownership and Reliability
dimensions.description: Good candidates show strong operational rigor by owning services end-to-end, participating in on-call rotations, and proactively improving system performance.
dimensions.jd_evidence: Own services in production end to end; Participate in on-call rotations; Improve system performance and reliability

dimensions.name: Distributed Systems and Data Storage
dimensions.description: Good candidates exhibit deep knowledge of distributed systems architecture, relational databases like Postgres and MySQL, caching, and message queues.
dimensions.jd_evidence: Relational databases; Postgres; MySQL; Distributed systems; Caching; Message queues; Load balancing

dimensions.name: Collaboration and Software Engineering Practices
dimensions.description: Good candidates effectively partner with cross-functional teams and maintain high code quality through automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and version control.
dimensions.jd_evidence: Collaborate with product and frontend teams; Git; CI/CD pipelines; Automated testing
